requirements.title: Governance and organisation - management body responsibility for ICT risk
ICT risk management framework (documented, reviewed annually, digital resilience strategy)
ICT systems, protocols and tools - resilient, reliable, sufficient capacity
Identification - business functions, information assets, ICT assets, dependencies, risk assessment
Protection and prevention - security policies, patching, network security, authentication, cryptography
Detection - anomalous activities, multiple layers of control, alert thresholds
Response and recovery - ICT business continuity policy, plans, testing, crisis communication
Backup policies and procedures, restoration and recovery
Learning and evolving - post-incident reviews, awareness and training
Communication - crisis communication plans, disclosure of major incidents
RTS on ICT risk management framework (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1774)
Simplified ICT risk management framework (small, non-interconnected entities)
ICT-related incident management process
Classification of ICT-related incidents and cyber threats (RTS 2024/1772)
Reporting of major ICT-related incidents - initial, intermediate, final reports
Harmonisation of reporting content and templates (ITS)
Digital operational resilience testing programme
Testing of ICT tools and systems (vulnerability assessments, scenario tests, penetration testing)
Advanced testing by threat-led penetration testing (TLPT) every three years
Requirements for testers of TLPT
General principles for managing ICT third-party risk; strategy; Register of Information (ITS 2024/2956)
Preliminary assessment of ICT concentration risk
Key contractual provisions for ICT services (Art. 30(2) all; Art. 30(3) critical or important functions)
Designation of critical ICT third-party service providers
Information-sharing arrangements on cyber threat information
